Two inclined elliptical legs have separated pointed caps and a dark crosshead that widens downward.
Extended and widened western anchorage terraces; closed their retaining faces and abutment ends after assembled review.
Distinct tan footways, grey cycle strips, white separators, linear drains, blue pickets and outboard horns match deck-level evidence.
limitations: Dimensions are image estimates except architect-confirmed 150 m total length.

North underside small fixtures, inscriptions and exact bolt inventory lack adequate evidence.

master_review.checks: Finite/nonzero geometry; full coplanar scan; forty road/path headroom rays; 56.6 m pylon tip.

export_review.district: Independent 6,000-triangle budget, three fixed 512-square atlas sets; clear open A-frame and rail silhouette. Fine pickets, lamps and outboard wires omitted. Thin cable and rail islands limit texture sampling.
export_review.viewer: Forced all three levels in GPU-backed assembled viewer, settled with no failed requests; Detail east oblique, west anchors, close upper footway and lower promenade reviewed.
export_review.support: 123 exported integration samples plus 99 neighbouring seam samples. Actual Walk mode followed the sloping upper footway. Lower promenade remained at eye height 3.9 m while crossing the bridge projection, forcing District and swapping the staged tileset.
export_review.overlap: Full float32 package scans and selected assembled cross-asset scans retain numerical/older-neighbour findings for review; no bridge internal or bridge/neighbour coplanar conflicts. Existing non-bridge findings are not asserted fixed.
